description: The pre-Nautilus-40 magic-first-line payload, with its trailing LF
notes: x-special/nautilus-clipboard was never a MIME type: it was a magic first line inside the text/plain payload (nautilus-clipboard.c 3.38.2 L88). Removed in Nautilus 40 by commit 2045f662. Unlike the modern format this one does have a trailing newline.
